name: Kubernetes connectivity check
description: Audit pod VIPs, OSPF adjacencies, ping paths and HTTP connectivity to peer NFs

phase.description: Checklist phase: vip, ospf, ping, curl or all

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing the target pods

ip_ausf.description: Remote AUSF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_udm.description: Remote UDM IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_smf.description: Remote SMF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_amf_remote.description: Remote AMF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_nrf.description: Remote NRF IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

ip_gnodeb.description: gNodeB IPv4 list, separated by commas or spaces

curl_ausf_urls.description: AUSF HTTP(S) URL list, separated by commas or spaces

curl_udm_urls.description: UDM HTTP(S) URL list, separated by commas or spaces

curl_smf_urls.description: SMF HTTP(S) URL list, separated by commas or spaces

curl_amf_remote_urls.description: Remote AMF HTTP(S) URL list, separated by commas or spaces

curl_nrf_urls.description: NRF HTTP(S) URL list, separated by commas or spaces

curl_connect_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to establish each NF HTTP connection

curl_max_time_seconds.description: Maximum total time for each NF HTTP request

curl_insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for HTTPS NF URLs
